questions.question: Factor: 6x² - 11x - 10
questions.explanation: AC method: a = 6, c = -10, ac = -60. Factors of -60 that sum to -11: -15 and 4. Rewrite: 6x² - 15x + 4x - 10 = 3x(2x - 5) + 2(2x - 5) = (2x - 5)(3x + 2).
steps: 2. Find factors of -60 summing to -11: -15 and 4.
questions.fastStrategy: AC method for tough quadratics: find factors of ac.

questions.question: Factor: x⁴ - 16
questions.explanation: x⁴ - 16 = (x²)² - 4² = (x² - 4)(x² + 4). Factor further: x² - 4 = (x - 2)(x + 2). So x⁴ - 16 = (x - 2)(x + 2)(x² + 4).
questions.fastStrategy: Difference of squares multiple times; note x² + 4 doesn't factor over reals.
